chunks.content:
Year 3Year 4Year 5Year 6
Invasion Games- NetballMake a series of passes to team mates moving towards a scoring area.Use a chest pass and shoulder pass to support team in scoring.Use all three passes (chest, shoulder & bounce) correctly.Know which pass is best to use and when in a game.
Show some signs of using a chest pass and shoulder pass.Make decisions regarding which is the best type of pass to use.Use a range of speeds within a game to support a team in scoring.Use a range of square & straight pass to change direction of the ball.
Show a target to indicate where I'd like to pass to.Begin to use a bounce pass, which only bounces once.Begin to use square (across the court) & straight (up & down the court) passes to achieve pace.Use landing foot to change direction to lose a defender.
